// diagnostic L0101

Jet.UnusedLocalBinding

Local binding `{name}` is never read.

What

Local binding `{name}` is never read.

Why

A binding that no later expression reads adds dead code and may hide a computed result that should have been used.

Fix

Remove the binding when its initializer is side-effect free, or rename `{name}` to `_{name}` when the value must be computed.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UnusedLocalBinding: Tests/UI/crypto_secret_local_operations.stderr.

Error: Jet.TraitNotImplemented: `Secret` does not implement `Encode`
  --> Tests/UI/crypto_secret_local_operations.jet:20:19
    |
 20 |     encoded: left.encode()
    |                   ^^^^^^
 Why: `.encode()` can only call the value's Encode contract
 Fix: Derive `Encode` on this type, or write its Encode implementation
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.TraitNotImplemented

Error: Jet.UnknownFunction: `Secret` has no method `clone`
  --> Tests/UI/crypto_secret_local_operations.jet:21:18

    |                  ^^^^^
 Why: Check the method name on this type
 Fix: Define it inside `Secret: struct` or `impl Secret`
